_nota: Descrizioni inglesi per le case che su Kross hanno solo il testo italiano. kross_sync.py non modifica questo file; la build le usa quando su Kross manca l'inglese.
castelfranco-23: The Castelfranco apartments, a short walk from the beaches, are ideal for a truly relaxing holiday. They offer comfort and convenience thanks to their closeness to the sea, with parking available on site. Each has 2 bedrooms, a living area with kitchenette and sofa bed, and two bathrooms.
appartamento-elisa: Welcome to Elisa, our very spacious apartment just a few steps from the sea, in the lively town centre. Its enviable location makes it ideal for a beach holiday full of relaxation and fun.

The apartment has a bright living room with two large sofas and a spacious, well-equipped kitchen area; a large bedroom with a double bed and a bunk bed, perfect for families or groups of friends; a second bedroom with a comfortable double bed; and two bathrooms, one with a shower and one with a bathtub.

There is also a balcony, perfect for a morning coffee or for unwinding after a day at the beach. The apartment is between the first and second floor and is easily reached by a few steps. Ceiling fans and mosquito nets make every stay pleasant and comfortable.
Book your dream seaside holiday and enjoy the best of our welcoming apartment!
moma: Spacious apartment a few steps from the sea, with a parking space and two balconies, one with a sea view and an outdoor table. Its location makes it ideal for a beach or active holiday. It has a bedroom with a double bed, a second bedroom with two single beds, a living room with dining table and sofa, a kitchen with dining table and a bathroom with bathtub. The apartment is on the sixth floor, with a lift.
ca-bolla: Beautiful apartment in the centre of Finale Ligure, a short walk from the sea, with a sea-view balcony. Located in the heart of town, it has a large 20 m² balcony overlooking the sea and furnished for dining outdoors: the perfect mix of comfort and breathtaking views for a relaxing holiday on the Ligurian Riviera.

Living room: bright, with a sofa bed and dining table, perfect for relaxing and spending time together. Bedrooms: one with a double bed and a second with a French-size double bed. Fully equipped kitchen with dining table and all the appliances you need. Bathroom with shower.
Extras: a secure bike room, ideal for mountain bikers, and a lift for easy access.

The central location, close to the sea, makes it easy to walk to the beaches, restaurants, bars and local shops. Sea views and comfort make this apartment the ideal choice for an unforgettable holiday in Finale Ligure.
profumo-di-sale: Welcome to Profumo di Sale ("Scent of Salt"), your perfect retreat! As the name suggests, here you can enjoy the sea breeze and the colours of the sea. On quiet Via Generale Enrico Caviglia, this newly renovated one-bedroom apartment is the ideal setting for your holiday.
Families or groups of friends can stay here comfortably, with up to 4 guests, in a perfect mix of modern design, comfort and an unforgettable view.
The terrace and sea view are the real gem of the apartment: from the living area you look out over the blue. The terrace is perfect for breakfast in the sun or a relaxing aperitivo at sunset.
Living area: open-plan and bright, with a cosy lounge (with a comfortable sofa bed) and a modern open kitchen with everything you need to cook your favourite dishes.
Bedroom: quiet and restful, with a comfortable double bed and a large wardrobe.
Bathroom and hallway: a practical hallway separates the sleeping area from the modern bathroom, finely finished with a large shower, and gives direct access to the outside.

Location: on Via Generale Enrico Caviglia you enjoy peace and quiet and a privileged view, while staying close to the beaches and all main services. It is the ideal base both for relaxing and for exploring the area.

In short: wonderful sea view and private terrace; fully renovated with new furnishings; up to 4 guests (double bed + sofa bed); equipped kitchen and bright living area; modern bathroom with shower; direct access to the outdoor areas.
We look forward to welcoming you for an unforgettable stay!
white-house: Welcome to Rivierarent White House, a fully renovated apartment on the 4th floor, designed to offer maximum comfort to large families and groups of friends.

As you step inside, you find a fresh, modern space: an elegant and practical bathroom on the left, and beyond it the heart of the home. The large living room with open kitchen is made for spending time together, with a big corner sofa for relaxing and a breakfast bar for quick breakfasts or aperitivi.
The sleeping area is one of its strengths, comfortably sleeping up to 8 people: there are two large, mirror-image bedrooms, each with a double bed and a bunk bed.
There is also a very handy private storage room on the ground floor, perfect for bikes, pushchairs or beach gear. A new, spacious and smart home, ready to be the ideal base for your holiday.
rustico-del-borgo: Rustico nel Borgo is a characterful home on several levels in Ranzi, in the quiet hamlet of Borgata Sant'Antonio, in the hills above Pietra Ligure.

It sleeps up to 3 people and is ideal for an authentic, relaxing stay away from the crowds, yet close to the sea. The entrance leads into the kitchen, followed by a first bathroom. Upstairs is the double bedroom with its own full bathroom, and on the second floor a small room with a single bed.
The real highlight is the panoramic terrace, furnished with a small table, perfect for breakfast outdoors, relaxing and enjoying a magnificent view over the Ligurian hills.

Perfect for couples, small families and travellers looking for an authentic village, Rustico nel Borgo combines the charm of Ligurian tradition with a welcoming, practical home. Ranzi is quiet and picturesque, ideal for walks and just a few minutes from Pietra Ligure, the sea and the main sights of the Riviera.
acquamarina: Welcome to Rivierarent AcquaMarina. Fully renovated and located on the first floor (no lift) on quiet Via dei Fuori in Borgio Verezzi, this bright apartment welcomes you with a characteristic Genoese-style hallway.

The living area has a lounge with a modern, high-quality minimalist kitchen, opening onto a lovely French balcony with a glimpse of the sea. The sleeping area offers a spacious main bedroom with wardrobe and a second bedroom with a double wall bed. There is also an elegant bathroom with shower and washing machine.
The whole apartment is for your private use, for a relaxing holiday in complete privacy. Tip: take a stroll through the shops of Borgio Verezzi to stock up on excellent fresh local produce.
House rules: smoking and parties are not allowed in the apartment. Please respect the quiet hours for the neighbours.
stellamarina: Stella Marina is a spacious, practical apartment, ideal for families and groups of friends, on Via del Centauro, a flat area close to the main services of Finale Ligure.

The entrance, with air conditioning, leads to the various rooms: on the left a cosy living room with sofa bed, on the right a separate kitchen with dining table, a handy storeroom and access to the balcony.
In the sleeping area there is a bedroom with two single beds, a bathroom with shower and a spacious double bedroom. Each bedroom has a portable fan.
The beach and seafront of Finale Ligure are about 600–900 metres away, a 10–12 minute walk depending on the route.

Nearby: supermarket about 200–400 m; bars, bakeries and shops about 300–500 m; bus stop about 200 m; Finale Ligure Marina railway station about 600–800 m (8–10 minutes on foot); pharmacy about 700–900 m; centre of Finale Marina about 800 m.
Thanks to its location, Stella Marina lets you walk to the sea, the station and the main services: a practical choice for a pleasant holiday in Finale Ligure.
ortensia: Fall for Ortensia, a spacious, bright apartment in the centre of Pietra Ligure, perfect for a seaside holiday with family or friends.

On the first floor and sleeping up to 6, it offers comfortable, well-arranged rooms. The airy living room has a double sofa bed and access to one of the two balconies, the perfect place to relax after a day at the beach.
The separate kitchen lets you prepare breakfast, lunch and dinner as you like. The sleeping area has a double bedroom and a second bedroom with two single beds. There is one bathroom.
The two balconies and dual aspect bring plenty of light and natural ventilation throughout the day.

The central location is one of Ortensia's real strengths: beaches, seafront, old town, restaurants, bars, shops and services are all within walking distance, so you can forget the car and enjoy Pietra Ligure freely.
Ortensia is the ideal starting point for an authentic holiday on the Ligurian Riviera, with all the space and comfort of feeling at home.
spazio-mare: Welcome to Rivierarent Spazio Mare, a bright and welcoming apartment on the 4th floor in the heart of Finale Ligure, ideal for families or groups of friends looking for comfort and convenience.

Location: the apartment is on Via Torino, an exceptionally convenient spot just a few steps from the beaches, the sea and the lively seafront promenade of Finale Marina. Supermarkets, bakeries, pharmacies, bars and good restaurants are all close by, so you won't need the car for everyday shopping.
Living area: a large living room with equipped kitchen, opening onto a practical balcony.
Main bedroom: a spacious double bedroom.
Second bedroom: a comfortable, roomy bedroom with 3 single beds.
Bathrooms: 2 full bathrooms, for privacy and no waiting.
